name: ReadyStack Payroll Tax Spreadsheet
author: readystack

sections.description:
Deposit short and the IRS adds 2% to 15% of the shortfall under IRC § 6656. This sheet stops Social Security at the wage base, stops FUTA at the first $7,000 per employee, and prints the exact Form 941 deposit for the check you are running right now.

The plugin adds one shortcode, [readystack_payroll_tax_spreadsheet]. Put it on any page or post and the tool runs in the browser. What it works out:

  • Your Payroll Numbers
  • This Paycheck (Employee)
  • Employer Cost & 941 Deposit
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Add the shortcode [readystack_payroll_tax_spreadsheet] to the page where you want the tool.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin send data anywhere?

No. Everything is worked out in the browser and nothing leaves the page.

Do I need an account or an API key?

No. The plugin is self-contained.
